title: Iron Deficiency and Diet: A UK Guide to Getting Enough
excerpt: Nearly a third of UK women are low in iron. Here's what actually boosts absorption, and what quietly blocks it.
author: Bite Insight Team
meta_title: Iron Deficiency and Diet: A UK Guide to Getting Enough
meta_description: Almost a third of UK women are low in iron. Learn the best food sources, what blocks absorption, and simple swaps that help your body take up more.
ai_summary: This guide explains why iron deficiency is so common in the UK, particularly among women, and breaks down the difference between haem and non haem iron. It covers who is most at risk, the warning signs to watch for, and practical food pairings that boost absorption, such as combining plant iron with vitamin C. It also explains what blocks absorption, like tea, coffee and dairy, and when to see a GP for testing rather than self supplementing.
